lesson.rule: 看到 must、can、will，後面直接選原形動詞。
lesson.howToJudge: 先找 must、can、will，下一格選沒有加 s、ed、ing 的動詞。

questions.question: All visitors must ___ at the front desk.
questions.note: must 後面接原形動詞 sign。

questions.question: The manager will ___ the report tomorrow.
questions.note: will 後面接原形動詞 review。

questions.question: You can ___ the meeting online.
questions.note: can 後面接原形動詞 join。

lesson.rule: 固定會做、每天會發生的事情，常用現在式。
lesson.howToJudge: 看到 every day、usually、always，優先找現在式。

questions.question: I ___ to work by bus every day.
questions.note: every day 表示每天都會做，所以用現在式 go。

questions.question: We usually ___ lunch at noon.
questions.note: usually 表示平常的習慣，所以用現在式 have。

questions.question: The store ___ at 9 A.M. every day.
questions.note: every day 表示固定習慣；the store 是一間店，所以用 opens。

lesson.rule: 事情已經發生了，要用過去式。
lesson.howToJudge: 看到 yesterday、last week、ago，優先找過去式，很多動詞會加 -ed。

questions.question: We ___ the report yesterday.
questions.note: yesterday 表示昨天，事情已經發生，所以用 finished。

questions.question: Ms. Wang ___ our office last week.
questions.note: last week 表示上週，事情已經發生，所以用 visited。

questions.question: I ___ my manager two hours ago.
questions.note: ago 表示多久以前，所以用過去式 called。

lesson.rule: before、after、at、without、for 等字後面常接名詞或動詞 -ing。
lesson.howToJudge: 介系詞後如果要接動作，動詞要改成 -ing。

questions.question: Please check the document before ___ it.
questions.note: before 後面接動詞時，要用 sending。

questions.question: Thank you for ___ our event.
questions.note: for 是介系詞，後面接 attending。

questions.question: He left the office without ___ goodbye.
questions.note: without 後面接動詞時，要用 saying。

lesson.rule: is、are、was、were 後面常接 -ing、過去分詞或形容詞。
lesson.howToJudge: 先看句子意思：正在做用 -ing；被安排、被完成常用過去分詞。

questions.question: The meeting is ___ for Friday afternoon.
questions.note: is scheduled 表示「已被安排」，用過去分詞。

questions.question: The employees are ___ on the new project.
questions.note: are working 表示正在工作，用 -ing。

questions.question: The documents were ___ yesterday.
questions.note: were sent 表示文件被寄出，用過去分詞。

lesson.rule: a、an、the 後面通常需要名詞。
lesson.howToJudge: 名詞常是人、事、物的名稱；常見字尾有 -tion、-ment、-ness。

questions.question: Please submit the completed ___ by Friday.
questions.note: the 後面需要名詞；application 是申請表。

questions.question: We received an important ___.
questions.note: an 後面需要名詞；announcement 是公告。

questions.question: The ___ starts at nine o'clock.
questions.note: the 後面需要名詞；meeting 是會議。

title: very 後面選形容詞或副詞

lesson.rule: very 後面通常接形容詞或副詞。
lesson.howToJudge: 形容詞常描述人或物；副詞常修飾動作，很多副詞以 -ly 結尾。

questions.question: The new software is very ___ to use.
questions.note: very 後面接形容詞；easy 是形容詞。

questions.question: The instructions are very ___.
questions.note: very 後面接形容詞；helpful 是有幫助的。

questions.question: Please speak very ___ during the presentation.
questions.note: speak 是動作，要用副詞 clearly 修飾。

lesson.rule: When 是問什麼時候，答案要是時間。
lesson.howToJudge: 找日期、星期、時間或時間段。

questions.question: When will the package arrive?
questions.note: When 問時間，所以選中午左右。

questions.question: When is the training session?
questions.note: On Monday morning 是時間。

questions.question: When did you send the email?
questions.note: Yesterday afternoon 是時間。

lesson.rule: Where 是問在哪裡，答案要是地點。
lesson.howToJudge: 找 in、at、on 加上地點，或直接是地點名稱。

questions.question: Where is the sales meeting?
questions.note: Where 問地點，所以選會議室。

questions.question: Where can I pick up my badge?
questions.note: At the reception desk 是地點。

questions.question: Where did you park the car?
questions.note: In the basement 是地點。

lesson.rule: Who 是問誰，答案要是人、姓名或職稱。
lesson.howToJudge: 找人名、部門人員、職稱或代名詞。

questions.question: Who will lead the presentation?
questions.note: Who 問人，所以選陳女士。

questions.question: Who approved this expense report?
questions.note: The finance director 是人。

questions.question: Who should I contact for help?
questions.note: IT representative 是人。

lesson.rule: Why 是問為什麼，答案要是原因。
lesson.howToJudge: 找 because、because of、to 加動詞，或明確的理由。

questions.question: Why was the flight delayed?
questions.note: Why 問原因，所以選因為暴風雨。

questions.question: Why are you leaving early today?
questions.note: To attend... 是離開的原因。

questions.question: Why did the printer stop working?
questions.note: 沒紙了是印表機停止運作的原因。

title: How much 問金額或不可數量

lesson.rule: How much 問價錢、金額，或不可數名詞的量。
lesson.howToJudge: 找金額；不可數名詞如 water、time、money 也用 how much。

questions.question: How much is the annual membership fee?
questions.note: How much 問金額，所以選 50 美元。

questions.question: How much time do we have left?
questions.note: time 不可數，所以用 how much。

questions.question: How much water should I bring?
questions.note: water 不可數，答案是水的量。

lesson.rule: How many 問可以一個一個數的東西。
lesson.howToJudge: 後面常接複數名詞，例如 people、books、applicants。

questions.question: How many applicants were interviewed?
questions.note: How many 問人數，所以選大約二十位。

questions.question: How many copies do you need?
questions.note: copies 可以一份一份數，答案要是數量。

questions.question: How many people will attend the event?
questions.note: people 可以計數，答案是人數。
